gatling.linePrev: That's the way it will be
gatling.line: We were seven years on the Burma shore with Gatling guns and paint
gatling.lineNext: Working the lowlands door-to-door, like a Latter-Day Saint
stanza: We were seven years on the Burma shore with Gatling guns and paint
Working the lowlands door-to-door, like a Latter-Day Saint
And then you turned me out at the top of the stair
You took all the glory that you just couldn't share
